compile_routing.note: teco_inductor (Torch-SDAA 3.1.1a3) cannot compile full LBM step chain; _CompileWithEagerFallback catches InductorError and falls back to eager. This is expected and documented in compile_route.py.

conclusion.reason: L<=32 cannot achieve <3% accuracy due to severe geometry under-resolution (hull radius < 2 cells). L=48 achieves -3.17% (slightly over threshold). L=80 achieves -1.15% (PASS). The +46% error from m319 (Cd=0.061495) was from an under-resolved (L=24) and under-stepped (~200 steps) run that had not converged.

figures.name: cd_convergence
figures.caption: Cd(L) convergence ladder: verified results (green) vs diagnostic (red). m319 result (orange star) at L=24. Blasius reference (blue dashed). Green band = ±3% acceptance.

figures.name: error_vs_resolution
figures.caption: Error vs resolution (symlog scale). R_cells annotation shows hull radius in grid cells. L<=32 has R<2 cells, causing severe geometry error.
